concepts.prompt: Game pickup item concept: an attack tonic. A faceted gem-cut glass bottle with bold angular facets, filled with glowing amber-orange liquid (orange and gold, NOT red), closed with a dark bronze metal stopper shaped like three curved claws gripping the neck, flat faceted base so it stands upright. Bold and fierce-looking. About 0.38 m tall. Stylised Palworld / Animo-class game item prop, deliberately chunky and oversized, exaggerated readable silhouette that still reads clearly from 10-15 metres, soft bevelled edges, soft hand-painted PBR look, natural palette matching the Meadows key-art reference (sage and leaf greens, warm gold, cream, slate blue, teal). Single isolated object standing upright on its flat base, full object visible and centred, plain neutral light-grey background, even studio lighting, no cast shadow, no ground plane, no people, no creatures, no text, no letters, no labels, no red or crimson anywhere.
concepts.verdict: CHOSEN: gem-cut faceted bottle, glowing amber-orange liquid, dark bronze three-claw stopper; 3 consistent views; reads orange, not red
